environment.description: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18.x) connected to Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 15.4 via RDS Proxy. The database connection is authenticated using IAM database authentication with the execution role's temporary credentials. The RDS instance has a pg_hba.conf equivalent configuration enforcing SSL. The DB_USER 'lambda_inventory_ro' was provisioned through a Terraform module that applies a restricted role: the role inherits from a base 'readonly_analytics' role and has an explicit column-level grant structure. Specifically, the role definition includes: GRANT SELECT ON inventory, inventory_audit_log TO lambda_inventory_ro; no other privileges are granted. A CHECK constraint exists on inventory.quantity (quantity >= 0 AND quantity <= 10000000) but this is on a DIFFERENT table partition not used by this warehouse. The RDS parameter group has 'log_statement=all' and pgaudit is enabled for compliance. Note: the Terraform state shows a GRANT UPDATE was applied in a prior deployment but was subsequently revoked in commit a]3f7b2; the current effective privileges reflect only the SELECT grant as confirmed by \dp+ output in the latest RDS snapshot.

config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT ON inventory TO lambda_inventory_ro; GRANT SELECT ON inventory_audit_log TO lambda_inventory_ro;
config.api_gateway: REST API, no request validator, proxy integration
config.check_constraint: ON inventory_partitioned (not inventory): CHECK (quantity >= 0 AND quantity <= 10000000)
config.terraform_history: UPDATE grant existed in prior state, revoked in commit a3f7b2
